scope: Read all 125 original numbered statements, their 119 attached proofs, and relevant inherited hypotheses; separately reviewed 55 new environments (54 arguments and 1 open problem). This is content and proof review, not universal correctness certification.
method: Manual mathematical reading; the assembler refreshes only source metadata and checks recorded correction markers and existing actual kernel records.
limits: No claim that every assertion in prose, every theorem in a cited source, or all inherited upstream files has been independently proved.
Six original general theorems remain cited external results; their statements and use were reviewed, not their full original source proofs reconstructed.
Empirical/source-attribution assessment of the Chomsky and language-model literature belongs to the separate root research review.

Experiment implementation audits, figure rendering, measured training results, and browser checks have separate records; this ledger records mathematical reading rather than independently rerunning those experiments.

Cosmology source attribution and synthetic-code verification are separate from this mathematical review. The missing centered-Gaussian hypothesis in the conditional-polarization formula was corrected by root and independently rechecked.
No complete composite manuscript environment is marked as kernel formalized. The claim register records narrowly typed partial components.

The Lean syntax covers typed sequential composition and one-hole contexts. It does not implement a full symmetric monoidal/traced/dagger graph syntax, channels, graph isotopy, parser correctness, completeness, or confluence.
No proof of GRH, a Yang--Mills mass gap, quantum computational advantage, or observational cosmological communication is asserted.

supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked acyclic composition and the Boolean intervention multiplexer. The same exogenous assignment is held fixed for the structural counterfactual; mechanisms are supplied, not identified from observations.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Observational ambiguity survives every learner
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked both observational distributions and their different do(X=0) laws. The impossibility is identification from the specified observational law, not inability of any architecture to compute a supplied mechanism.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: A learned policy inherits certified rewrite correctness
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked soundness is pathwise for every finite accepted sequence of certified rewrites and independent of a possibly history-dependent rule-selection policy.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Bounded-variable exponential bound
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the exponentially tilted variance bound by 1/4 and Taylor integration for all real lambda, including negative lambda.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Uniform error for a finite candidate family
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Added and rechecked K,m>=1. Checked iid evaluation independent of fixed candidates, exponential Markov/union bounds, the 1-X lower-tail argument, and the empirical-minimizer 2-epsilon risk bound.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Connection change and null trajectories
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked torsion-free metric compatibility gives the conformal connection formula, the null geodesic rescaling, and its converse. The conformal factor is smooth, finite, and strictly positive on the stated domain; the singular crossover is excluded.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Hodge scaling and the four-dimensional Maxwell system
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked p-form and volume scaling in arbitrary signature, wedge nondegeneracy, and source-free Maxwell invariance for n=4,p=2. Detector energy, charged matter, and boundary regularity are separate assumptions.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Quartic compactification and conformal time
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the four simple branch points, two unbranched points at infinity, connectedness, Euler characteristic, and nonvanishing differential in all charts. The real expanding branch and coefficient-field extension qualifications are explicit; a repeated-root quartic is excluded.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Spin lowering and Stokes invariance
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked symmetric spinor contraction annihilates the symmetrized derivative, divergence plus complex self-duality implies closedness, and Stokes gives equality for the bounding oriented piecewise-smooth chain with smooth fields. This is conditional on the two displayed field equations.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Classical data processing
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked nonnegative finite relative entropy, both mutual-information chain rules, and the conditional Markov version. No sender or end-to-end physical channel is constructed by the inequality.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Identifiability and its quantitative obstruction
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the signed variation decomposition, stochastic-kernel contraction, and exact 1/K success bound for observationally identical equally likely messages, including abstention.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Finite records and a decoding requirement
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the finite alphabet entropy bound and conditional-error decomposition for Fano's inequality. Independent decoder randomization can be adjoined without changing message mutual information.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Trace-distance contraction
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked positive/negative parts of a Hermitian difference and trace preservation give trace-norm contraction; zero trace and 0<=E<=I give the measurement bound. Complete positivity is not needed for this particular conclusion.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: No deterministic cloning of nonorthogonal pure states
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the two-state trace-distance formula and strict increase under tensor squaring for overlap strictly between zero and one; deterministic channel contraction excludes the proposed cloning map.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: No signalling by a local unconditioned operation
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the Kraus completeness relation, rectangular trace cycling, and equality against all observables imply equal reduced states after an unconditioned local operation.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Quadratic-form moments
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked Gaussian diagonalization, quadratic mean/variance, linear variance, and vanishing third-moment cross term. Replaced the misleading word centered for the noncentered chi-square sum.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: A fixed-template matched filter
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked nonzero fixed template and known positive covariance give a strictly convex scalar likelihood, inverse-information variance, and normalized score law. Data-driven template selection is treated separately.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Finite Monte Carlo rank calibration
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked exchangeability gives a uniform descending rank without ties and counting the entire tied block gives a conservative p-value. A fitted-parametric bootstrap is not asserted automatically exact.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: The elementary full-sky cosmic-variance calculation
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked isotropic harmonic covariance plus Gaussianity gives independent real coefficients and variance 2 C_l^2/(2l+1). The argument uses the standard irreducibility of a fixed-degree spherical-harmonic space; masked-sky estimators are excluded.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: A forecast with linear nuisance templates
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked full-column-rank nuisance design, whitening, orthogonal projection, and the Schur-complement information. Vanishing exactly characterizes template confounding; the variance assertion requires positive remaining information.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: An end-to-end cross-aeon inference problem
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Reviewed as an explicitly open end-to-end physical/inference problem, not a proved theorem. Required crossover solutions, identifiable source laws, calibrated observables, and encoding comparisons remain tasks.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Bellman recursion on a finite token DAG
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked finite backward induction, existence of outgoing choices, attainment, and termination on the ordered DAG. Negative edge costs do not invalidate the recursion because directed cycles are absent.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: A checkable primal--dual certificate
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the edge-potential inequalities telescope to a lower bound, equality certifies a legal path, and Bellman potentials attain it. Prediction accuracy and certification/repair success remain distinct.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Integral unit flows on an ordered DAG
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Added and rechecked distinct source and target. Checked extraction of one positive integral path, subtraction, and absence of any remaining nonnegative zero-boundary DAG circulation.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: An exact lower bound from a rational LP dual
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked all weak-duality inequality signs: z<=0 reverses the H constraint, u<=0 uses x<=1, and x>=0 permits multiplication of the coordinate dual bound. Equality certifies only the specified feasible instance.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Finite Weyl relations and matrix basis
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the backward cyclic shift gives VU=omega UV, the nontrivial character sum vanishes, and q^2 nonzero orthogonal Weyl matrices form the matrix basis. Rational phase does not mean rational matrix entries.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Normalization and feature bounds
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked unitary gate normalization, Hermitian observables for real/imaginary Weyl expectations, feature range, and the two-term norm perturbation bound. Separate preparations can be needed for noncommuting observables; the reported model uses exact simulated expectations.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Single-occurrence Pauli parameter shift
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the Pauli exponential expansion, real sinusoidal expectation, and plus/minus pi/2 shift rule for one gate occurrence. The full nonlinear loss is not assigned this two-evaluation rule.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Hybrid gradient with shared parameters
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the multivariable chain rule with independently named occurrences, summation over shared offsets/tokens, and original-feature classical adjoints. Reused input angles need both occurrence contributions; max-plus ties do not have a unique derivative in general.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Associativity of finite max-plus contraction
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked finite maxima can be reordered and regrouped, with max(empty)=-infinity explicitly set. The conclusion applies to fixed score/value contractions, not to the whole nonlinear network.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Equivariance of the implemented mathematical architecture
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked token permutation through feature maps, row operations, two-sided score permutation, soft/max attention, and separately normalized dispatch/combination. Endpoint renaming preserves equality data; byte attributes and padding masks must be transported.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: The binomial kernel of the boundary code
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked grouping by equal Laurent exponent gives the full binomial kernel and path incidence telescopes. The grading incidence convention is separated from the opposite flow convention before the following proof.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: A constrained rewrite preserves legal tokenization
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked zero-boundary integral rewrites plus explicit nonnegativity preserve the unit-flow constraint and hence a legal path only under the ordered-DAG hypotheses. Cost change is exactly the linear functional of the rewrite.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: Preserving a finite affine sign pattern
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the strict affine margin bound, its Cauchy--Schwarz sufficient condition, and constant-score case. A nonlinear encoder can have a disconnected/nonpolyhedral inverse image of a feature-space region.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: A conservative circuit-offset perturbation bound
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked each independent offset occurs in one Pauli gate, whose derivative norm is 1/2; telescoping unitary products gives the l1 state bound and six expectation bounds give the sqrt(6) feature bound. Token inputs and the encoder are held fixed.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: The parity semigroup is normal in its own group
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the generated even-sum lattice, explicit even/odd nonnegative decompositions, and saturation relative to that lattice. The point (1,0) is outside the group and is not a saturation hole there.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: A point, a circle, and a filled triangle
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked the triangle boundary matrix has rank two and kernel span(1,1,1); the filled triangle adds that image. The point/boundary/fill inclusions give first Betti numbers 0,1,0, disproving both unqualified monotonicity directions.

supplemental_new_chapters.name: A constraint-preserving variational interface
supplemental_new_chapters.manual_review_note: Checked nonempty feasible basis set, a normalized initial vector, and unitaries commuting with its projector imply subspace preservation and probability-one feasibility. The diagonal cost expectation is a convex average, and a positive nonoptimal cost gap gives the stated probability bound. This is a conditional future interface, explicitly not the trained three-qubit feature circuit.

additional_prose_checks: Centered joint Gaussian hypothesis added to the conditional polarization formula; original formula would be false with arbitrary nonzero means.
Predictive codelength gain checked as C0-C1=sum log2(q1/q0), with a separately subtracted artifact cost B. Positive observed-symbol probabilities and normalized distributions are explicit.

The tiny graph binomial example eliminates z_c=z_a z_b and gives the stated unit-flow interval and affine cost wall. Abelianized boundary invariance does not preserve arbitrary extra trajectory semantics.
